## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor with a size-one dimension inserted |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Dimension | `dim` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Position at which to insert the singleton dimension. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Unsqueeze is a tensor graph utility node; PipelineExecutor tensor shape execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as a resolved singleton-dimension insertion layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
unsqueeze(0) adds batch dim, unsqueeze(-1) adds at end.
```

## Tips

- Add batch dim: unsqueeze(0)
- Add channel dim: unsqueeze(1)
